text:
For the first time in forever… the holidays are coming to Arendelle! ❄️🎄#DisneyUnscripted
Ever wonder what it takes to transform Disneyland Paris into a winter wonderland? In this episode of Disney Unscripted, we're going behind the scenes to see how Disney teams bring the holiday magic to life!

From decking the halls across Disneyland Paris to preparing World of Frozen for its FIRST-ever holiday season, discover the creativity, craftsmanship, and festive details that make this time of year extra magical. Think sparkling Christmas trees, whimsical gingerbread-inspired ornaments, and plenty of holiday cheer! ☃️🎁

Come along as we unwrap the magic behind the merriest season at Disneyland Paris!

Holidays at Disneyland Paris:

From November 7, 2026 to January 6. 2027, unwrap the magic of Christmas, Disney style, where festive decorations, seasonal entertainment, and Disney Characters bring both parks to life throughout the holiday season.

NEW! For Christmas 2026, experience the enchantment of the season the Arendelle way in the all-new World of Frozen at Disney Adventure World. Gather your nearest and dearest alongside Anna, Elsa and friends for a festive moment filled with wonder you'll never let go!

text:
Decorating World of Frozen for the Holidays | Disney Unscripted
For the first time ever, the holidays are coming to Arendelle! ❄️🎄

Go behind the scenes at Disneyland Paris to see how cast members and teams across the resort work together to bring the holiday season to life. In this episode of Disney Unscripted, we follow the crews preparing World of Frozen at Disney Adventure World for its first-ever Christmas. Watch as Arendelle is transformed with Nordic-inspired decorations, a towering Christmas tree and festive details that make the kingdom feel like a holiday dream.

Along the way, see how the holiday magic spreads across both parks, from the classic Christmas sparkle of Disneyland Park to the first holiday season at the newly reimagined Disney Adventure World. Through overnight installs and finishing touches, it all builds to a special holiday moment with Olaf, joined by Queen Anna, Queen Elsa and The Arendelle Carollers.

Come along as we unwrap the teamwork, creativity and craftsmanship behind the merriest season at Disneyland Paris!
